documents.title: 한국은행 총재 김유택, 추가 통화조치 부인·산업자금 융자 계획 담화
documents.source_kind: contemporaneous press report of BOK governor statement
documents.notes: Governor denies another new monetary measure; reports $20m foreign-currency loans, expected 12억환 recovery and $70m UNKRA activities. All future plans and speaker assertions, not bank-ledger verified.

documents.title: 이승만 대통령 경제부흥 담화·유엔군 대여금 8700만달러 수일내 상환 예상
documents.source_kind: contemporaneous press transcription of president statement
documents.notes: Rhee says USD87m expected to arrive in coming days and USD70m reconstruction funds to be used by June; not evidence of bank receipt. Compare Paik Feb28 USD85m already settled claim.

documents.title: 민주신보 재정 1년간 회고(하): 통화개혁 실패 주장과 정책효과 비판
documents.provenance_family: Korean contemporary Minju Sinbo (independent editorial family)
documents.notes: Editorial asserts currency reform failed and subsequent foreign-currency releases indicate weakness; evaluative commentary not quantitative impact evaluation. Contrast later BOK official retrospective with chronology and metrics.

documents.title: 서울시 비상미 1만1000석·구호양곡 9300석 발표 뒤 동회 배급 지연 보도
documents.notes: City announced emergency rice 11,000 seok and relief grain 9,300 seok, credit distribution pending new notes; report says only few neighborhoods received and some demanded new banknotes. Announced quantity not delivered quantity.
